title: Auto Loans: interest day-count basis and payment application settings
content:
# Auto Loans: interest day-count basis and payment application settings

This card lists, for every Auto Loans product at PCB, the settings that govern how interest is counted and how a payment is applied: the days in the year used for daily simple interest, the order in which a payment is applied, whether paying more than one installment moves the next due date forward, whether a principal-only payment is allowed and its smallest amount, and the prepayment penalty.

## Meaning of each setting

- **Day-count basis**: the days in the year used for daily simple interest, in whole days.
- **Application order**: the order in which each payment is applied, as an ordered list drawn from fees, interest and principal.
- **Overpayment advances due date**: whether paying more than one installment moves the next due date forward (yes or no).
- **Principal-only payment allowed**: whether a payment may be designated to principal only (yes or no).
- **Smallest principal-only payment**: in USD.
- **Prepayment penalty**: the penalty on paying the loan off early, as a percent of the principal prepaid.

## Settings by product

| Auto Loans product | Day-count basis (days) | Application order | Overpayment advances due date | Principal-only allowed | Smallest principal-only payment (USD) | Prepayment penalty (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 365 | fees, then interest, then principal | no | yes | 50.00 | 0.00 |

## Quick answers

**What day-count basis does an Auto Loans product use for daily simple interest?** A 365-day year on every product.

**Does any product charge a prepayment penalty?** No; the penalty is 0.00 percent on all six products.

**Which comes first when a payment is applied?** Fees, then interest, then principal, on every product.

**Can an extra payment move the next due date forward on any product?** No; the overpayment setting is "no" throughout.

**Is 49.99 USD enough for a principal-only payment?** No. The smallest principal-only payment is 50.00 USD on every product; 50.00 meets it.
